episodes.name: Hands
episodes.overview: While Liz is settling in to her new life and career in Los Angeles, Max , Isobel and Michael are figuring out if the stranger in the cave, with the familiar face, is friend or foe.

episodes.name: Give Me One Reason
episodes.overview: Jones fills Michael and Isobel in on bits from the past as they look for a way to save Max’s life. Meanwhile, Maria goes to extremes to try and stop a murder, and in order to move forward in her research, Liz will have to face her past.

episodes.name: Black Hole Sun
episodes.overview: Liz confronts Max. Maria is desperate to figure out the mystery of her vision and Isobel is learning more about her abilities. Meanwhile, Kyle has a strange encounter and Michael is fueled by his anger.

episodes.name: Walk on the Ocean
episodes.overview: Isobel and Maria take a trip together to look for answers. Kyle receives a message from his past. Michael makes a disturbing discovery.

episodes.name: Killing Me Softly With His Song
episodes.overview: Liz makes the choice to lie to Heath. Maria and Rosa stand up to Jordan. Isobel does some digging into Jones.

episodes.name: Bitter Sweet Symphony
episodes.overview: Max investigates the break-in meanwhile, Alex continues his research. Rosa and Isobel team up and Liz makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Goodnight Elizabeth
episodes.overview: Liz's plan does not go as expected, putting herself, Isobel and Michael in danger. Meanwhile, Eduardo confides in Alex.

episodes.name: Free Your Mind
episodes.overview: Liz needs Rosa's help. Maria learns what Jones wants from her. Michael and Alex team up to help save Max.

episodes.name: Tones of Home
episodes.overview: Liz and Max continue to search for a way to stop Jones. Michael is worried about Alex and elsewhere, Isobel finds a big piece of the puzzle.

episodes.name: Angels of the Silences
episodes.overview: Liz and Max race to find Heath in the hopes that he can help find a way to get Jones out of Max's body. Meanwhile, Michael and Isobel try to get through to Dallas.

episodes.name: 2 Become 1
episodes.overview: A desperate Liz agrees to a deal. Meanwhile, Rosa helps Isobel make a big discovery and the fight to save Max begins.

episodes.name: I Ain't Goin' Out Like That
episodes.overview: Isobel helps Kyle save a life. Jones needs something from Michael. Liz and Heath continue to work on the science in the hopes of stopping Jones. Everyone is working together to try and defeat the dictator.

episodes.name: Never Let You Go
episodes.overview: The ultimate showdown with Jones is finally here and Liz must trust herself if she is going to the save the man she loves.
